name: inwr_pylon
description: X-truss METL pylon with an INWR anchor point at the apex for a crossing-safe catenary wire run.
why: Build-lessons 'INWR for buried and overhead signal runs': INWR conducts SPRK only along itself, never to neighbouring conductors, so it can hang between two conductive METL pylons without shorting the truss. Connect two instances with {"line": "INWR", "from": "p1.top", "to": "p2.top"}.
source: save2, METL X-truss pylons x36-100 y246-306 with INWR catenaries y265-299
